providers.baseUrlPlaceholder: Empty for the service’s official address
providers.baseUrlOptional: Leave empty for the service’s official address.
providers.baseUrlRequiredForCustom: Required for a custom provider — the full OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint URL.
providers.editIntro: The model, base URL and model tuning change here without re-entering the API key. A field left empty goes back to the built-in default.
providers.maxOutputTokensHint: The longest answer allowed. A model that “thinks” before answering (DeepSeek, o1…) needs more. Empty: the shared value.
providers.requestTimeoutSecondsHint: How long to wait for an answer. Empty: the shared value.
providers.maxCorrectionAttemptsHint: How many times to retry an unusable answer. Empty: the shared value.
providers.imageUnsupported: "{{provider}}" cannot generate images today — only OpenAI and Stability can. The image model entered here will be ignored and this provider stays a text-only provider.
providers.testNeedsEnabled: Enable the provider to test it.
providers.removeBody: The provider and its saved API key will be deleted. Agents and the assistant that use it will move to another enabled provider, or stop if there is none. To use it again you will have to enter the key again.
providers.noProviders: No provider yet. Add one below to use the assistant and the agents.
providers.allDisabledNotice_one: No AI provider is active: {{providers}} is saved but disabled. Enable it to use the assistant and the agents.
providers.allDisabledNotice_other: No AI provider is active: {{providers}} are saved but disabled. Enable one to use the assistant and the agents.
